ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the figure, point $A(-1, m)$ lies on the line $y=2x+3$. When connecting $OA$ and $\angle AOB=90^\circ$, point $B$ is on the line $y=-x+b$ and $OA=OB$. What is the value of $b$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Substituting point A ($-1$, $m$) into the line equation $y=2x+3$, we get: $m=-2+3=1$,\\
since $\angle AOB=90^\circ$ and $OA=OB$,\\
therefore, rotating line segment $OA$ around point $O$ clockwise by $90^\circ$, we obtain line segment $OB$. Hence, the coordinates of point $B$ are ($1$, $1$),\\
substituting point $B$ into the line $y=-x+b$, we get: $1=-1+b$,\\
therefore $b=\boxed{2}$.
